kit.note: Default branch main is the generated installable app (tiged / laravel new --using=URL with no branch suffix). Source of truth is develop. Regenerate with bin/kit materialize --push; never hand-edit main. Optional Packagist: set composer_name and publish (Composer version dev-main).
